paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space
caption: figure
model_annotation: The grouped bar chart illustrates scores across three distinct quality score categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Quality Scores," presented in the order of IFD, TagNum, and DEITA. The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "Scores," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 30 to 70 with numerical tick labels placed at intervals of 5 units. Within each category, two bars are grouped side-by-side: a light blue bar representing "$Avg_{obj}$" on the left and a light peach bar representing "$Avg_{sub}$" on the right, as indicated by the chart's legend. Exact values are annotated directly above each bar. For the IFD category, the $Avg_{obj}$ bar measures 63.98 and the $Avg_{sub}$ bar measures 41.90. In the TagNum category, the $Avg_{obj}$ bar is 66.06, while the $Avg_{sub}$ bar is the shortest overall at 39.13. For the DEITA category, the $Avg_{obj}$ bar is the tallest in the chart at 67.64, paired with an $Avg_{sub}$ bar of 42.99. The categories are not arranged in a strict alphabetical or ascending/descending order. Additionally, the chart features visual emphasis through two horizontal dashed lines spanning the width of the plot space: a blue dashed line representing "Base $Avg_{obj}$" at a value of 64.71, and an orange dashed line representing "Base $Avg_{sub}$" at a value of 37.91, both with their specific values annotated on the right side of the plot area.
